chunks: the good behaviour of your father deceived me about you and I thought that you would follow his way and tread in his path. But according to what has reached me about you, you are not giving up following your passions and are not retaining any provision for the next world. You are making this world by ruining your next life, and doing good to your kinsmen by cutting yourself off from religion.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'building this world by ruining the next' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this letter to an administrator, Imam Ali (AS) contrasts the son's deviation with his father's piety, highlighting how personal desires (hawa) led to the neglect of the hereafter (akhirah). He criticizes the administrator for building his worldly life (dunya) through the ruin of his spiritual state and severing religious ties (qati'at din) for the sake of kinship. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing worldly duties with spiritual accountability, where administrative roles are seen as trusts requiring integrity beyond mere familial loyalty.
